name: loom
description: Skills for AMD Loom (hrx-loom / loom-serve): install, fetch and serve catalog models, a web playground, port any GGUF LLM or diffusers text-to-image model to Loom, optimize it while preserving correctness, benchmark it against llama.cpp ROCm or stable-diffusion.cpp, and migrate packages, cards and skills to a new SDK release.
